summary: Request for legacy LDAP provisioning script and onboarding notes
description: Background: IT is preparing a small pilot in our Dublin office that requires provisioning a handful of older Linux workstations that rely on legacy LDAP bind flows and a deprecated onboarding script (pre-SSO era). The original provisioning script lived in a private Bitbucket repo archived in 2019. Request: locate the legacy LDAP provisioning script, a README or onboarding notes, and any runbook steps so we can adapt them to our temporary network. Impact: small batch of 10 workstations, targeted timeline 2026-04-01. Constraints: no outbound internet for the pilot machines during onboarding; will need an offline-compatible package bundle and service account credentials. Acceptance criteria: 1) Script located and verified runnable in an isolated VM; 2) List of dependencies and credentials handling notes; 3) Archive of artifacts uploaded to shared drive and linked in ticket.
comments: Samira Patel (2024-11-18): Filing this after we found machines in storage that lack modern SSO configuration. Low priority but timebound due to pilot date.
Liam O'Connor (2024-11-19): I'll take a look. Do we have any idea which team last touched the Bitbucket archive? @infra?
Alex Gomez (2024-11-20): I remember a 'legacy-onboard' folder in the infra-archives project. Might be under repo infra-archives/old-scripts. I can check and share a link.
Liam O'Connor (2026-03-09): Quick status update: located several candidate scripts and a README. Some references to hardcoded hostnames—need to sanitize. Will try running in a VM tomorrow.
Samira Patel (2026-03-10): Thanks — please upload artifacts to shared_drives/it/pilot-dublin and ping #it-ops when done.
